problem: Automatic heartbeat was stopped before terminal complete/fail, leaving the remaining lease headroom dependent on the timing of the last periodic heartbeat while terminal persistence may wait on serialization/fsync contention.

independent_reviews.reason: Refreshes authority immediately before terminal persistence while preserving lease-token fencing as the coordinator authority.
Fails closed if final renewal fails and avoids accepting terminal mutations after authority is uncertain.

Adds one existing heartbeat mutation per terminal path, with no new process, daemon, database, IPC, or Qubes dependency and a smaller regression surface than concurrent terminal-heartbeat coordination.

alternatives.name: keep-current-ordering
alternatives.rejected_because: Terminal persistence inherits arbitrary residual lease headroom from the previous periodic heartbeat.

alternatives.name: keep-heartbeat-running-during-terminal-mutation
alternatives.rejected_because: A heartbeat racing after successful completion can observe terminal state and report an error, creating ambiguous success/failure ordering without additional coordinator protocol.

alternatives.name: terminal-reservation-or-supervisor-protocol
alternatives.rejected_because: Stronger but materially expands coordinator/runtime protocol and regression surface before measured evidence shows it is necessary.

tradeoffs.correctness: Improves terminal authority headroom and remains fenced by lease token.
tradeoffs.robustness: Final renewal failure prevents terminal success and is surfaced through existing fail-closed handling.
tradeoffs.latency: Adds one durable heartbeat mutation before terminal complete/fail.
tradeoffs.resource_use: No new long-lived resource; one additional mutation and persistence cycle per terminal path.
tradeoffs.regression_risk: Localized to WorkerRuntime terminal ordering and covered by mock-contract regressions.

qa: Quick successful execution with no periodic heartbeat must perform exactly one renewal before complete.
Execution failure with no periodic heartbeat must perform exactly one renewal before fail persistence.
Existing automatic-heartbeat-loss test must still prevent completion.
Existing event-loop-starvation fencing test must still reject stale terminal authority.
Full test:mission-runtime remains required before Slice 1 can be frozen.
lessons: Periodic heartbeat health and terminal persistence authority are related but distinct concerns.
Stopping periodic renewal is safe only after deliberately restoring terminal lease headroom or after introducing a stronger atomic terminal protocol.
Do not keep heartbeat racing blindly through completion without defining terminal-state heartbeat semantics.
readiness_impact: LAB READY only until independent executable QA is green.
